scope: New proposals from current real retailer products, independent of Amy’s original design. No model or image-generation output modified.
price_note: US prices inspected 2026-10-08 before tax/shipping, dependent on variant and promotional stock. IKEA local availability is not verified without a ZIP.

palette.architecture: Preserve measured existing light wood floor, brick fireplace, doors/closet and windows. Calm warm-white walls.
palette.new_items: Black-brown worktop, white closed storage, charcoal/ivory graphic rug, slate-teal accent upholstery, warm brown wood, selective bold cobalt art.
palette.keepers: User’s Pheasantwood 42×30 in UPLIFT top / industrial gray C-frame, white Honeywell 02E Pro lamp and brown MUTTROS 59-inch wicker basket cat tree.

recommended_for_parent_to_choose.shoes: grejig-shoes × 2, inside existing closet if physically compatible
recommended_for_parent_to_choose.task_seating: branch-pro (1 or 2 according to final two-workstation plan)
recommended_for_parent_to_choose.graphic_art: art-blue-geometric + art-black-frame; optional companion Bold Blue

meaningful_alternatives.secondary_workspace: Single ALEX desk is cheaper and gives more knee/chair space; dedicated clothes chest still supplies clothes capacity.
meaningful_alternatives.folded_clothes_storage: STORKLINTA oak effect is 70 cm wide, costs $100 less and has greater published capacity, but is 75 cm tall.
meaningful_alternatives.rug: Ruggable 5×7 flatwoven is smaller/easier to fit and adds blue; costs more.
meaningful_alternatives.visitor_lounge: Beige EKENÄSET fallback if Last Chance turquoise is unavailable.

excluded: No PAX/wardrobe: existing closet already handles hanging storage. No Amy furniture carried forward automatically. No dresser top substituted for usable knee-space work surface.

items.name: IKEA LAGKAPTEN / ALEX desk, two 5-drawer pedestals
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.function: Actual desk-height workspace; 5 drawers on each side. ALEX is office/light-item storage, not the dedicated folded-clothes chest.
items.material: Foil black-brown grained top; white drawer fronts with cutout pulls; LAGKAPTEN top is a lightweight honeycomb construction, not solid wood.
items.limits: No verified ALEX internal drawer heights or capacity; do not depict giant clothes drawers. Room planning should include chair base and pullout space.

items.name: IKEA LAGKAPTEN / ALEX desk, one 5-drawer pedestal and two legs
items.selected_color: Black-brown top / white drawers and legs
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.function: Same usable work surface with a wider chair/knee area; best alternative if the separate clothes chest supplies storage.

items.name: IKEA ALEX 5-drawer pedestal
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.limits: Retailer only supplies interior depth. No verified clothes-storage volume; keep the separate clothes chest.

items.name: IKEA NORDLI 4-drawer low dresser
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.

geometry.drawer_layout: 2 columns × 2 rows; broad cutout handles; low plinth
geometry.height_correction: Current US 4-drawer model is only 53 cm high, not the older tall modular dresser.

items.limits: Dedicated folded-clothes storage. Source calls for securing to wall. Current page rating 2.6/5 from 31 reviews, mostly mixed assembly feedback; alternate below has warmer finish and greater published capacity.

items.name: IKEA STORKLINTA 3-drawer dresser
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.material: Oak-effect surfaces; modern closed flush drawer fronts.
items.limits: Dedicated clothes dresser, not a second desk. Anchor/unlock wall attachment is part of the product design.

items.name: IKEA GREJIG stackable shoe rack
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.placement_intent: Inside the bottom of existing closet if its internal depth/width allows, preserving hanging access and approach.
items.material: Powder-coated steel wire/mesh; actual official photo governs appearance.

items.name: IKEA TRONES shoe/storage cabinet, 2-pack
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.placement_intent: Alternative only if closet rack fails fit; keep the door/stair/closet route clear.
items.material: Matte polypropylene tilting bins, not wood drawers.
items.limits: Requires wall attachment; two vertically stacked units total about 78 cm high before mounting offset.

items.name: IKEA EKENÄSET armchair
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.material: Actual photographed cool dark gray-turquoise/slate-teal corduroy upholstery, warm brown wooden arms and legs.
items.availability_note: Current official page says Last Chance; store/delivery availability needs the destination ZIP.
items.function: Compact relaxed visitor chair; foam and spring seat. Do not count its reclined lounge posture as a full task-chair workstation.

items.name: IKEA EKENÄSET armchair
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
items.material: Light beige woven upholstery, warm brown wooden frame.
items.availability_note: Current sale while supply lasts. Neutral fallback; blue remains in art/rug if this replaces turquoise.

items.name: Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro, mesh / standard cylinder
items.nominal_dimensions_note: Retailer nominal commercial measurements; not physically measured.
